column1: # Frozen trigger-gating fixture (test item T-I2). 20 utterances: 10 that must
# load the critical-thinking skill, 10 that must not.
# Frozen means frozen: rows are added, never edited to make a run pass. The hash
# in tests/fixtures.tsv is what enforces that. If a real utterance is
# misclassified, it goes in as a new row FIRST and the trigger table changes
# after — the same discipline as a red-team set (docs/test-design.md §0 rule 3).
# What this fixture can and cannot prove: 20/20 here means these 20 are handled.
# It says nothing about the phrases nobody thought of. The negative half is the
# valuable half, and half of it is deliberately near misses — utterances that
# contain a *fragment* of a trigger and must still not fire:
#   分析化學    contains 分析 but not the phrase 分析論證
#   我的計劃    contains 計劃, which is not a trigger at all (紅隊 is)
#   紅色的隊服  contains 紅 and 隊 but never adjacent
#   unbiased    contains the letters of `bias` inside a longer word
# Columns (tab-separated):  utterance <TAB> expect <TAB> note
#   expect  the skill name that must load, or `-` for none
